versos.grego: Τί οὖν ἐροῦμεν εὑρηκέναι Ἀβραὰμ τὸν προπάτορα ἡμῶν κατὰ σάρκα;

controles.web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
controles.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
controles.livre: Então, que diremos que Abraão, nosso ancestral segundo a carne, obteve?

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ Ἀβραὰμ ἐξ ἔργων ἐδικαιώθη, ἔχει καύχημα· ἀλλ’ οὐ πρὸς Θεόν,

controles.web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
controles.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
controles.livre: Pois se Abraão foi justificado pelas obras, ele tem do que se orgulhar, mas não diante de Deus.

versos.grego: τί γὰρ ἡ γραφὴ λέγει; Ἐπίστευσεν δὲ Ἀβραὰμ τῷ Θεῷ, καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.

controles.web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
controles.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
controles.livre: Pois o que diz a Escritura? Abraão creu em Deus, e isso lhe foi lhe imputado como justiça.

versos.grego: τῷ δὲ ἐργαζομένῳ ὁ μισθὸς οὐ λογίζεται κατὰ χάριν ἀλλὰ κατὰ ὀφείλημα·

controles.web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
controles.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
controles.livre: Ora, ao que trabalha, seu pagamento não é considerado um favor, mas sim, uma dívida.

versos.grego: τῷ δὲ μὴ ἐργαζομένῳ, πιστεύοντι δὲ ἐπὶ τὸν δικαιοῦντα τὸν ἀσεβῆ, λογίζεται ἡ πίστις αὐτοῦ εἰς δικαιοσύνην,

controles.web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
controles.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
controles.livre: Porém, ao que não tem obra, mas crê naquele que torna justo o ímpio, sua fé lhe é reputada como justiça.

versos.grego: καθάπερ καὶ Δαυεὶδ λέγει τὸν μακαρισμὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ᾧ ὁ Θεὸς λογίζεται δικαιοσύνην χωρὶς ἔργων

controles.web: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,
controles.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
controles.livre: Desta maneira, também Davi afirma que bendito  é aquele a quem Deus atribui justiça independentemente das obras:

versos.grego: Μακάριοι ὧν ἀφέθησαν αἱ ἀνομίαι καὶ ὧν ἐπεκαλύφθησαν αἱ ἁμαρτίαι·

controles.web: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
controles.kjv: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
controles.livre: Benditos  são os que têm as transgressões perdoadas, e seus pecados são cobertos.

versos.grego: μακάριος ἀνὴρ οὗ οὐ μὴ λογίσηται Κύριος ἁμαρτίαν.

controles.web: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”
controles.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
controles.livre: Bendito é o homem a quem o Senhor não atribui pecado.

versos.grego: ὁ μακαρισμὸς οὖν οὗτος ἐπὶ τὴν περιτομὴν ἢ καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ἀκροβυστίαν; λέγομεν γάρ Ἐλογίσθη τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ἡ πίστις εἰς δικαιοσύνην.

controles.web: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.
controles.kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
controles.livre: Ora, essa bendição  é somente para os circuncisos, ou também para os incircuncisos? Pois dizemos que a fé a Abraão foi reputada como justiça.

versos.grego: πῶς οὖν ἐλογίσθη; ἐν περιτομῇ ὄντι ἢ ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ; οὐκ ἐν περιτομῇ ἀλλ’ ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ·

controles.web: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
controles.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
controles.livre: Como, pois, lhe foi reputada? Enquanto ele estava na circuncisão ou na incircuncisão? Não na circuncisão, mas sim, na incircuncisão.

versos.grego: καὶ σημεῖον ἔλαβεν περιτομῆς σφραγῖδα τῆς δικαιοσύνης τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐν τῇ ἀκροβυστίᾳ, εἰς τὸ εἶναι αὐτὸν πατέρα πάντων τῶν πιστευόντων δι’ ἀκροβυστίας, εἰς τὸ λογισθῆναι αὐτοῖς τὴν δικαιοσύνην,

controles.web: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.
controles.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
controles.livre: E ele recebeu o sinal da circuncisão como selo da justiça da fé quando ainda era incircunciso, para que fosse pai de todos os que creem, ainda que não estejam circuncidados, para que a justiça  também  lhes seja imputada;

versos.grego: καὶ πατέρα περιτομῆς τοῖς οὐκ ἐκ περιτομῆς μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τοῖς στοιχοῦσιν τοῖς ἴχνεσιν τῆς ἐν ἀκροβυστίᾳ πίστεως τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ.

controles.web: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.
controles.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
controles.livre: e para que fosse pai da circuncisão, dos que não somente são circuncidados, mas que também andam nos passos da fé do nosso pai Abraão, quando ainda não era circuncidado.

versos.grego: Οὐ γὰρ διὰ νόμου ἡ ἐπαγγελία τῷ Ἀβραὰμ ἢ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ, τὸ κληρονόμον αὐτὸν εἶναι κόσμου, ἀλλὰ διὰ δικαιοσύνης πίστεως.

controles.web: For the promise to Abraham and to his seed that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
controles.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
controles.livre: Pois não foi pela Lei que a promessa de ser herdeiro do mundo foi feita a Abraão ou à sua descendência, mas sim, pela justiça da fé;

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ οἱ ἐκ νόμου κληρονόμοι, κεκένωται ἡ πίστις καὶ κατήργηται ἡ ἐπαγγελία·

controles.web: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.
controles.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
controles.livre: porque, se é da Lei que são os herdeiros, logo a fé se torna vazia, e a promessa é anulada.

versos.grego: ὁ γὰρ νόμος ὀργὴν κατεργάζεται· οὗ δὲ οὐκ ἔστιν νόμος, οὐδὲ παράβασις.

controles.web: For the law works wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.
controles.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
controles.livre: Pois a Lei produz ira, mas onde não há Lei, também não há transgressão.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο ἐκ πίστεως, ἵνα κατὰ χάριν, εἰς τὸ εἶναι βεβαίαν τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν παντὶ τῷ σπέρματι, οὐ τῷ ἐκ τοῦ νόμου μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ τῷ ἐκ πίστεως Ἀβραάμ, (ὅς ἐστιν πατὴρ πάντων ἡμῶν,

controles.web: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.
controles.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
controles.livre: Por isso é pela fé, para que seja conforme a graça, a fim de que a promessa seja confirmada a todos os descendentes,  não somente aos que são da Lei, mas também aos que são da fé de Abraão, que é Pai de todos nós,

versos.grego: καθὼς γέγραπται ὅτι Πατέρα πολλῶν ἐθνῶν τέθεικά σε,) κατέναντι οὗ ἐπίστευσεν Θεοῦ τοῦ ζωοποιοῦντος τοὺς νεκροὺς καὶ καλοῦντος τὰ μὴ ὄντα ὡς ὄντα·

controles.web: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.
controles.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
controles.livre: (como está escrito: “Eu te constituí pai de muitas nações”)  diante daquele em quem ele creu, Deus, que vivifica os mortos, e chama as coisas que não são como se já fossem.

versos.grego: ὃς παρ’ ἐλπίδα ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι ἐπίστευσεν εἰς τὸ γενέσθαι αὐτὸν πατέρα πολλῶν ἐθνῶν κατὰ τὸ εἰρημένον Οὕτως ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα σου·

controles.web: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your seed be.”
controles.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
controles.livre: Com esperança, Abraão creu, contra as expectativas, que se tornaria pai de muitas nações, conforme o que lhe fora dito: “Assim será a tua descendência”.

versos.grego: καὶ μὴ ἀσθενήσας τῇ πίστει κατενόησεν τὸ ἑαυτοῦ σῶμα νενεκρωμένον, ἑκατονταετής που ὑπάρχων, καὶ τὴν νέκρωσιν τῆς μήτρας Σάρρας·

controles.web: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.
controles.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara’s womb:
controles.livre: Ele não fraquejou na fé, mesmo considerando o seu próprio corpo já praticamente morto (pois já era de quase cem anos), e o ventre de Sara em estado de morte ;

versos.grego: εἰς δὲ τὴν ἐπαγγελίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ διεκρίθη τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ, ἀλλὰ ἐνεδυναμώθη τῇ πίστει, δοὺς δόξαν τῷ Θεῷ

controles.web: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,
controles.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
controles.livre: nem duvidou da promessa de Deus; pelo contrário, fortaleceu-se na fé, dando glória a Deus;

versos.grego: καὶ πληροφορηθεὶς ὅτι ὃ ἐπήγγελται δυνατός ἐστιν καὶ ποιῆσαι.

controles.web: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.
controles.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
controles.livre: e teve plena certeza de que aquele que havia prometido também era poderoso para cumprir.

versos.grego: διὸ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην.

controles.web: Therefore it also was “reckoned to him for righteousness.”
controles.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
controles.livre: Por esse motivo que também isso lhe foi imputado como justiça.

versos.grego: Οὐκ ἐγράφη δὲ δι’ αὐτὸν μόνον ὅτι ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ,

controles.web: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,
controles.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
controles.livre: Ora, não só por causa dele está escrito que lhe foi imputado;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ καὶ δι’ ἡμᾶς, οἷς μέλλει λογίζεσθαι, τοῖς πιστεύουσιν ἐπὶ τὸν ἐγείραντα Ἰησοῦν τὸν Κύριον ἡμῶν ἐκ νεκρῶν,

controles.web: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,
controles.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
controles.livre: mas também por nós, a quem será imputado, aos que creem naquele que ressuscitou dos mortos a Jesus, nosso Senhor,

versos.grego: ὃς παρεδόθη διὰ τὰ παραπτώματα ἡμῶν καὶ ἠγέρθη διὰ τὴν δικαίωσιν ἡμῶν.

controles.web: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
controles.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
controles.livre: que foi entregue por nossos pecados, e ressuscitou para a nossa justificação.
